pages.title: Aldabra Giant Tortoise
pages.text: The Aldabra giant tortoise ($(o)Aldabrachelys gigantea$()) lives on Aldabra Atoll in the Seychelles, in the Indian Ocean.$(br2)It has a high, domed, dark brown shell, thick scaly legs and a long neck, and large males can weigh over 250 kilograms.$(br2)About 100,000 live on Aldabra, and some have been released on small islands off Mauritius to take the place of its extinct giant tortoises.
